review_candidates.description: Company Description GSS Contracts Ltd is a UK-wide specialist in commercial refrigeration, air conditioning, and HVAC solutions for retail and hospitality businesses. Since 2014, the company has supported supermarkets, convenience stores, forecourt stores, hotels, and restaurants with reliable, energy-efficient systems designed to protect critical stock and operations. With 80+ qualified engineers operating from Glasgow headquarters and regional offices in York, Stafford, and Tunbridge Wells, GSS offers fast, coordinated support through a Central Help Desk. The company provides end-to-end turnkey solutions, from consultation and bespoke design to installation and ongoing maintenance for refrigerated displays, cold rooms, freezers, and comfort cooling systems. GSS focuses on long-term partnerships, delivering expertise, accountability, and responsive customer service across Scotland, England, and Wales. Role Description The Refrigeration Engineer role at GSS Contracts Ltd is a full-time remote position focused on servicing commercial clients across the UK. Day-to-day responsibilities include diagnosing faults, carrying out maintenance and repair on refrigeration, CO2, and air conditioning systems, and performing preventive maintenance to ensure optimal performance and compliance. The role involves attending customer sites, completing accurate service reports, and collaborating with the Central Help Desk and engineering team to prioritize and schedule work efficiently. The Refrigeration Engineer will ensure adherence to safety standards, support system upgrades and installations, and communicate clearly with customers to explain findings, recommendations, and next steps. This remote role requires flexibility to travel within assigned regions and maintain professional standards in all customer interactions. Qualifications Strong technical skills in Maintenance & Repair and Preventive Maintenance for commercial refrigeration and HVAC systems. Hands-on experience working with CO2 refrigeration systems and related safety and regulatory requirements. Solid foundation in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline, supported by relevant vocational training or qualifications. Effective Customer Service skills, including clear communication, professionalism onsite, and the ability to build long-term client relationships. Refrigeration and air conditioning certifications (e.g., F-Gas or equivalent) and knowledge of UK standards and regulations. Ability to work independently in a remote, field-based role, manage time and travel efficiently, and complete documentation accurately. Experience with commercial retail or hospitality environments and familiarity with refrigerated displays, cold rooms, and freezers is beneficial. Full UK driving license and willingness to travel within assigned regions.
